dog.description_text: Meet Banana Pudding — New Arrival! Banana Pudding just arrived at the adoption center and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Since Banana Pudding is a recent arrival, we don’t have much background information or many personality notes yet, but we’ll be updating their profile as we get to know them better. Every day reveals something new, and we’re excited to learn all the little quirks, preferences, and habits that make them unique. If you’re open to a little patience and a lot of possibility, come meet Banana Pudding! You might be the person who helps them feel safe, confident, and right at home. Check back for updates—or stop by to say hello and discover who Banana Pudding is becoming.
dog.name: Banana Pudding
